policies: The library is open 8 AM to 10 PM Monday through Thursday, and 8 AM to 6 PM on Friday.
Course drop refunds are available only before the end of the second week of the semester; after that no refund is issued.
Student parking permits cost $120 per semester and are purchased through the Student Services portal.
Students may request an incomplete grade for bereavement by contacting the Dean of Students office within 14 days of returning to class.
The Learning Center offers free tutoring Monday through Thursday from 9 AM to 5 PM.
Guest Wi-Fi passwords expire every 24 hours and can be regenerated in the Student Services portal.
